output.subject: new vp of marketing at reco
output.body:
I saw that on 8 June 2026 you were appointed Vice President of Marketing at Reco. That role puts you in a prime position to sharpen pipeline targets and lower cost per opportunity, especially as outbound growth often stalls without adding SDR headcount and generic sequences see falling reply rates. Would you be open to a 15‑minute call to explore how an outbound pipeline engine could help your team build pipeline without additional SDRs?

Shivam
